related.title: Suomi NPP 氣象環境衛星
related.titleEn: Suomi NPP weather and environment satellite
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層表、單位轉換、積分與解析度限制，不以格點密度冒充量測解析力。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layers, conversions, integral and resolution limits without equating grid density to resolving power.
related.difference: 建立夜間低光影像的背景扣除與跨景比較，避免月光和雲誤當人造照明改變。
related.differenceEn: Build background-subtracted low-light comparisons without confusing moonlight or cloud with changing artificial illumination.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將 1 km 轉成 100000 cm，逐層算柱量並以柱狀圖累加。
先扣背景再除增益，另算錯誤順序以顯示單位不一致。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 1 km to 100000 cm, calculate each layer column and accumulate a bar chart.
Subtract offset before dividing by gain; test the reversed order to expose inconsistent units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: James Webb 太空望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層表、單位轉換、積分與解析度限制，不以格點密度冒充量測解析力。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layers, conversions, integral and resolution limits without equating grid density to resolving power.
related.difference: 計算譜線紅移與解析需求，區分單線猜測與多線一致識別。
related.differenceEn: Calculate line redshift and resolution requirements,distinguishing a single-line guess from consistent multi-line identification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將 1 km 轉成 100000 cm，逐層算柱量並以柱狀圖累加。
分別算 z 與 R，說明兩者皆無量綱但意義不同。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 1 km to 100000 cm, calculate each layer column and accumulate a bar chart.
Calculate z and R separately and explain their different meanings despite both being dimensionless.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
